artworks.title: The Windmill
artworks.description: The image features a windmill to the left, with detailed sails reaching into the sky. There is a small building with a thatched roof connected to the windmill. In the background, the horizon line is low, highlighting the vast sky. The etching shows intricate linear strokes, creating a textured surface, especially visible on the windmill with cross-hatching. The image is monochromatic in varying shades of brown and tan, giving an antique vibe. The landscape fades into the distance towards a faint skyline, emphasizing the serene and open environment.

artworks.title: The Small Lion Hunt (with Two Lions)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of wild animals and foliage. The illustration depicts lions in motion, surrounded by dense vegetation and intricate detailing. The use of black ink creates contrast and depth, emphasizing the energetic and dynamic nature of the scene.

artworks.title: The Baptism of the Eunuch
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing various figures in a pastoral landscape. There is an elder figure with a staff, two smaller figures kneeling before him, and another figure holding a shield or umbrella on the right side. On the left side, there is a mounted soldier in elaborate armor and helmet with feathers, holding a spear. The background includes trees and foliage. The lines are finely drawn in a meticulous and detailed composition typical of a classical style.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child in the Clouds
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child visible from the waist up. The woman is seated and holding the child in her arms. She has a shawl over her head. The child is also wrapped in fabric or a blanket. The woman wears long, flowing garments with intricate drapery. There are no visible jewelry or objects, and the background consists of linear shading with lines emanating from behind the figures. The setting is abstract, adding to the timeless quality of the image.

artworks.title: Cornelis Claesz Anslo
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated at a table. He is holding a thick book in his left hand and using a quill in his right hand. He has a thick beard and mustache, and is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, fur-trimmed clothing, and is surrounded by books. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Cornelis Claesz Anslo
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a seated person at a table. The individual is leaning forward with arms resting on the surface. They have a full beard, mustache, prominent nose, and deep-set eyes. Their hair is covered by a wide-brimmed hat. The person wears a garment with fur trim and a large collar. Several large, open books are on the table, and they hold a quill pen in one hand, potentially writing or referencing the pages. The background is a textured plain wall, and the scene appears to be drawn or etched onto a flat surface.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in a Dark Chamber
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person seated at a desk indoors. The person is bent over an open book. Details of the person's appearance are not clear due to the shadows. The person seems to have a head covering and is wearing layered clothing. The scene includes a large open book, dim lighting, shadows from a spiral staircase, and a window with a grid pattern letting in light. The atmosphere is intense and subdued, with light and darkness emphasizing the rustic setting.

artworks.title: Christ Disputing with the Doctors: a Sketch
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded interior scene with multiple figures engaged in conversation or thought. The artwork features numerous people gathered in a densely packed space. In the center of the composition, a figure stands in a gesturing pose. Surrounding this central character, individuals are depicted in various postures – some seated, others standing close together. The artist uses fine, meticulous lines to create detailed textures and expressions, capturing the fabric of the clothing and the faces. The use of cross-hatching adds depth and shadow to the scene, particularly in the background where an elevated platform suggests heightened activity or status. This is in the style of Rembrandt, characterized by its detailed and mastery of light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds: a Night Piece
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on japan paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a dimly lit night scene with figures gathered around a light source. The artwork uses chiaroscuro to highlight the central action with a lantern illuminating a group of figures on the left side while leaving the rest of the composition in deep shadow. Some figures appear to be looking towards or holding the light, with others partially obscured by the darkness. This is in the style of Rembrandt, known for his use of light and shadow to create dramatic scenes. The contrast focuses the viewer’s attention on the drama unfolding in the illuminated area, with textures and details revealed only within the reach of the lantern's glow.

artworks.title: The Blindness of Tobit: the Larger Plate
artworks.description: The image displays an elderly man in profile, standing and slightly bent forward as he knocks on a closed wooden door. The man has a long beard, wears a long robe or cloak, and a wide-brimmed hat that obscures much of his facial features and hair. He holds a walking stick in one hand and uses the other to gently knock on the door. At his feet, a small dog is also depicted in profile, its tail raised. The background shows an interior setting with rustic elements, including a wooden wheel and a wooden ladder-like structure leaning against the wall. There is a large wooden chair with a high back featuring intricate carvings or patterns. Hanging from the ceiling or upper wall is a set of unidentifiable objects. The image is rendered with cross-hatching techniques, suggesting an etching or similar artwork style.

artworks.title: Clement de Jonghe
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: This print shows a person seated on a chair, depicted from their knees up. The individual is seated facing forward, with one arm resting on the chair's arm and the other hand resting on their lap. They have a long nose, deep-set eyes, and a thin mouth that appears to be in a slight smile. They have chin-length hair with a broad-brimmed hat partially covering it. The person is a wearing buttoned garment with a collar and a large cape over their shoulders. The background is gray, with some thin cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: Clement de Jonghe
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper [counterproof]
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a wooden chair, facing the viewer directly, covered by a large cloak. His head is slightly turned to one side, wearing a wide-brimmed hat. He has a straight nose, a slight mustache, and medium-length hair peeking out from under the hat. He wears a buttoned shirt with a wide collar beneath the cloak, with no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain with sketch lines, emphasizing the subject in the chair.

artworks.title: Clement de Jonghe
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a person seated on a chair. The individual is leaning slightly toward the left, with their left arm resting on the chair's arm and the right hand positioned on their lap. They have narrow eyes, a straight nose, slightly parted lips, and shoulder-length hair beneath a wide-brimmed hat. The person is dressed in a loose, buttoned garment with a collar, gloves, and a cloak or similar outer garment draping over their shoulders. The background is plain and textured, with a suggestion of a rounded arch or structure drawn above and behind the seated figure.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees, Farm Buildings and a Tower
artworks.description: The image features a rural landscape with a thatched-roof building slightly to the right, a horizon in the distance blending into a line of trees. The brushstrokes show fine details, with cross-hatching creating texture in foliage and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, using dark and light shades to depict contrast in sunny and shaded areas. The sky has light cross-hatching. Close to us, the ground is open and textured, leading to buildings and trees.

artworks.title: Landscape with an Obelisk
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural and natural elements. A tall detailed structure is on the left, and a thatched roof building is on the right. The horizon is visible in the distance with faint outlines of roofs and structures suggesting a village. The image uses a monochromatic palette with shades of gray and black, highlighting the contrast between the structures and the ground.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Milkman
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky. In the foreground, there is a boat near a creek surrounded by dense trees. A pathway leads to thatched-roofed cottages in the distance. A figure with baskets is seen mid-ground. The color palette is monochromatic, in black and white tones typical of etchings. Faint outlines of ships are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Medea, or the Marriage of Jason and Creusa
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on European (white) paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural interior with a gathering of figures. The scene is intricately detailed, depicting numerous figures gathered in a richly adorned architectural setting. The composition is dominated by towering arches and columns that draw the eye upwards. The left side of the drawing features a group of figures standing in a cluster, and on the right, a figure is seated on an elevated platform and approached by two other figures dressed in elaborate attire. Light and shadow are used effectively, especially in the folds of the drapery and the textures of the stone and fabric, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Medea, or the Marriage of Jason and Creusa
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring a gathering with architectural elements and figures engaged in a formal occasion. The drawing presents a large hall with lofty arches and columns. Numerous figures are assembled in two distinct groups on stone steps. A central figure is depicted on an elevated platform, gesturing or speaking to another seated figure. The use of hatching and intricate line work gives depth to the architectural interior and captures the attention on gathered figures. Light filters dramatically through large windows, adding focus to the central action. Draped curtains frame the drawing.

artworks.title: Beggars Receiving Alms at the Door of a House
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.6 x 12.9 cm (6 9/16 x 5 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The print shows five people standing around an opening in a wall on the left. A man on the far left stands in a dark doorway, extending his left hand out. He has light skin and a long, white beard, and he wears a tall hat and a robe-like garment with a high collar. His right hand reaches into his robe. In front of him stands a group including another bearded man in a wide-brimmed hat and cloak, a woman wearing a headscarf and a full-length dress holding a basket and walking stick with a bundled child hanging from her back, and a short person with their back to us, perhaps another child, wearing a torn top hat and tunic. The woman reaches out towards the man in the doorway, and he appears to hand her something small. The background of the print is beige paper.

artworks.title: Beggars Receiving Alms at the Door of a House
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures interacting at a doorway. The etching portrays a detailed scene in which one character stands at the threshold of a building, engaging with a group of people on the outside. The group includes figures clad in humble clothing, with one appearing to extend a hand. Textures are richly rendered, emphasizing the emotional tone. Architectural details and shading demonstrate a keen interest in realism.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome beside a Pollard Willow
artworks.description: The image is an etching featuring an old tree dominating the scene. The horizon is low, obscured by the tree and vegetation, with no prominent features visible directly on it. The tree has detailed, cross-hatched lines giving it a textured appearance, showcasing the artist's meticulous etching technique. Close to us, there is a lion's head emerging from the grass, and to the right, a man with a beard sits. The color palette is monochrome, with black lines on a cream background, highlighting the linework and creating a contrast of light and shadow. Sparse landscape elements are visible in the distance, rendered in lighter lines, suggesting a natural environment extending beyond the tree and figures.

artworks.title: The Artist Drawing from the Model
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior with figures and a bust. The image features an elaborate setting that includes a bust adorned with drapery on the right side, against a dark background. In the foreground, there is an incomplete outline of a standing figure holding a palm frond. To the left, there appears to be a seated figure sketchily drawn, surrounded by abstract line work hinting at furniture or architectural elements. The combination of detailed shading and lightly drawn lines creates a sense of depth and space, highlighting an interplay between the finished and unfinished parts of the drawing.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Etching at a Window
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.9 x 13 cm (6 1/4 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated and viewed from the waist up. He has a round face with prominent cheekbones, a mustache, and small, deep-set eyes. His head is covered by a wide-brimmed hat. He wears a dark coat and holds a paper or book, with his hand appearing engaged in writing or reviewing it. The setting appears to be indoors near a large window on the left side, showing an outdoor view. The background is dark with contrasting lighter tones of the window and the textural details of his clothing.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Etching at a Window
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated at a window, seen from the waist up. He is leaning on the windowsill with his right elbow, holding a writing implement in his right hand above a stack of papers or books. The man has a wide-brimmed hat on his head and is wearing a dark garment. His face shows prominent cheeks and a thoughtful expression, and the view outside the window includes trees and structures.
